nodes.title: Owner: use Vertex AI for everything Google/Gemini (text brains, TTS voices, Live ears and speech-to-speech), in the product and the lab.

Gemini runs only through Vertex (project vp-voice, from India). The Gemini API key route and the OpenRouter Gemini route are retired from the product and the lab. A Gemini model or feature that Vertex does not offer makes its stack unavailable, with a plain reason. It is never rerouted to the API key or OpenRouter.
nodes.rationale: Owner directive. It also leaves one credential, one project and one data-terms regime for Google, which is what the reinstatement appeal described. The OpenRouter and API-key routes existed only as workarounds while Vertex was restricted and the keys were capped.
nodes.reverse_if: A model the owner wants is only on the Gemini API (e.g. a Live model with no Vertex release), or Vertex quota in India cannot carry the product's concurrent calls.
